tone_statements.quote: TONES ma55 high level ma33 mid level ma13 low rising ma21 low falling • In [JZ-Yi], tones are represented by Chao tone letters, not numbers. • Some occurrences of the /13/ tone are in polysyllabic Chinese loanwords.
tone_statements.locator: p.435, entry 'Yi: Dafang', TONES; tone numbers superscript on the page
tone_statements.summary: Inventory compendium: Dafang Yi (from ZMYYC 1991) has four tones 55, 33, 13, 21; the pooled Noesu entry (Chen 1986, p.302) lists ma55 ma33 ma21 ma13 without labels. Nothing on TBU or sandhi.

tone_statements.citation: Chen Kang 陈康. 1986. Questionnaire. Unpublished STEDT phonological-inventory questionnaires on Yi varieties (siglum CK-YiQ), Sino-Tibetan Etymological Dictionary and Thesaurus project, University of California, Berkeley. Source of the Ahi, Lalo, Li, Nasu, Nesu, Noesu, Nosu and Nyi entries in Namkung (ed.) 1996; the Noesu inventory (Weining, Hezhang, Dafang, Bijie, Qianxi Counties, Guizhou) is printed there at p.302.
tone_statements.quote: NOESU Data Source: Chen 1986 [CK-YiQ] Spoken in Weining, Hezhang, Dafang, Bijie, and Qianxi Counties, Guizhou. Inventory: Chen 1986 [CK-YiQ] ... TONES ma55 ma33 ma21 ma13
tone_statements.summary: Bare chart: four tones on dummy syllable ma, Chao values 55 33 21 13. No tone prose; editor's schema: 55 high level, 33 mid level, 21 low falling.
